description: This file defines the IGrainState<T> interface and its implementation GrainState<T> for managing grain state in Orleans, including properties for state data, ETag for concurrency, and existence flag.

classes.name: GrainState
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IGrainState<T> that manages grain state data, ETag, and record existence, with constructors for initialization.

methods.name: GrainState
methods.description: Constructor initializing GrainState with a state value and optional ETag.
